Consider the following system of equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}x+2y=8 \\ 2x-y=6\end{aligned}
$$

Use the diagram below to determine this system's solution $(x,y)$.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14180603/assets/6f0b7960b9b4c98250741b009da2ad19c1123c5b7adf9cd5072430fb9a879dc9.png)
current_example.worked_solution:
The solution of the system corresponds to the point of intersection of the lines. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14180603/assets/5c1c69adc880ea7cfdb5a4e0a10abd6032d2eedf0386923b94df9b7c173edd6d.png)

In this case, we have the point $(4,2).$ Therefore, the solution to the given system is $(4,2).$
